text:
NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author didn't push new code, but both asks were about the description, and the description now has them. It has screenshots of the `/emails` page for the HTML and text versions, in both password-enabled and SSO-only cases, plus the self-review checklist.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Before/after screenshots from `/emails`, HTML and text, for both cases |
| ✅  | Self-review checklist is in the main PR description |
| ℹ️  | The approach differs from the one in the issue: the PR hides the reset link for SSO-only realms. timabbott suggested linking to a /help/ guide on compromised accounts. A reviewer should confirm this is acceptable |
| ℹ️  | The checklist leaves "Responsiveness and internationalization" unchecked. This is minor for an email text change |

**Reviewer:** @laurynmm — gave the feedback and already knows the PR's history

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign laurynmm.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the screenshots and the checklist! @laurynmm, could you review this?
```
